threads.body: This eagerly reads and buffers the entire embedding response, then wraps it again, which can create a large peak-memory footprint for high-dimension embeddings. Consider using a sync `StreamingBody` wrapper that finalizes telemetry when the caller reads/closes the body (similar to the async wrapper behavior), which avoids upfront buffering at the cost of deferring span completion until the body is consumed.
